summary: Saved dashboard filter presets reset when editing a linked sub-report
description:
Issue summary: Customers report that when they open a dashboard with saved filter presets and then edit an embedded sub-report (open editor modal -> save metadata), the dashboard's selected filter preset reverts to the default. Impact: Persistent loss of saved view state for analysts; repeated manual re-selection required and automated alerts tied to specific presets fire incorrectly. Environment: prod, us-east region, console v4.3.2 frontend, query-service v2.8. Steps to reproduce:
1) Log in as org admin with saved dashboard presets.
2) Open dashboard 'Monthly SLA Overview' and select saved preset 'Tiered-90p50'. Confirm widgets update.
3) Open a linked sub-report by clicking "Edit report" on widget (opens editor modal).
4) Change a non-filter attribute in the sub-report (e.g., chart title) and save.
5) Close modal. Observe dashboard filter preset has reset to 'Default (All)'.
Logs / traces: Console frontend logs show filterState reset event at same timestamp as sub-report save. Query service shows no query for preset change. Behavior started being reported after console v4.3.0 -> v4.3.2 deploy (rolled 2026-03-10).
Workaround: Do not use "Save and propagate" option when saving sub-report; save as draft or use separate edit workflow. Temporary manual reselect of preset restores view.

2026-03-13 14:02 - Frontend Eng (Priya Menon): Confirmed handler added in PR 4521 that changed post-save behavior. Adding to investigation. Will try disabling propagation of 'presets:clear' to global store.

2026-03-14 09:30 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Deployed hotfix branch to staging that prevents modal save from dispatching 'presets:clear' globally. Staging tests show preset persistence preserved after sub-report save. Planning canary to prod if no regression in 6h.

investigation_notes: Initial triage: high impact for scheduled alerts tied to named presets. Multiple customers reported after v4.3.2 deploy.
Frontend instrumentation: event 'presets:clear' is dispatched from report-editor component after successful save. Previously the editor only updated local report metadata.
Trace correlation shows event timestamp aligns exactly with preset state mutation in Redux global store; no server-side call to change presets detected.
Related PR: frontend PR 4521 introduced 'propagateChanges=true' option used by editor save path. Reverting propagation stops symptom but requires review for other intended side effects.
Risk assessment: hotfix is low-risk UI change; must ensure no other consumers expect propagation side effect (noted by analytics team relying on propagation for auto-bump alerts).
resolution_notes: Hotfix branch created that scopes post-save events to local editor state (branch hotfix/disable-global-preset-clear). Staging validation passed with NimbleDocs QA. Canary deploy to 10% of prod users scheduled 2026-03-14 16:00 UTC. Full rollout planned after 6h no-regression window. Follow-up action: add unit test to prevent global dispatch and add an e2e test verifying preset persistence when editing linked sub-reports.
next_steps: 1) Complete canary to prod and monitor dashboards/alerts for any regressions. 2) Merge hotfix to main and include in next patch release notes. 3) Create a ticket to add integration tests in console e2e suite. 4) Notify customer once canary complete and confirm closure.
workaround: Advise customers to avoid using 'Save and propagate' for sub-report edits until hotfix deployed. Use 'Save as draft' or edit reports via the Reports workspace to avoid triggering modal save path.
